name: streamvault.cash
description: Non-custodial PUSD streaming payroll and subscription vault on Bitcoin Cash (BCH BLAZE 2026)

paragraphs: PUSD allowance for people and AI agents. A non-custodial streaming vault on Bitcoin Cash, enforced by CashScript covenants and relative timelocks.

Live demo: · built for BCH BLAZE 2026 Agent demo: open the app, keep Agent selected, and use the Sandbox Fast-Track. No wallet or funds are required. Formerly AgentPay.cash. The original agent-allowance thesis is now the Agent tab; payroll is the second use case. Before / after disclosure: baseline code · before demo · current demo
features: Sub-cent settlement: BCH fees (1 sat/byte) make per-period micro-settlement economically viable.
UTXO covenants: introspection opcodes let the contract prove that change returns to the identical
Relative timelocks: this.age (OPCHECKSEQUENCEVERIFY) natively encodes "at least N blocks since this
CashTokens: PUSD is a native fungible token, so the covenant can enforce token conservation on-chain.
